scenario: Counterfactual: two-lane station-402920 mapping to NB US-101 HOV connector

additional_ramp_mappings.name: Counterfactual mapping; station is likely on southbound SR-85 on-ramp

additional_assumptions: PeMS identifies station 402920 as a southbound SR-85 on-ramp; the nearest generated network feature is a two-lane ramp feeding southbound CA-85. Its measured flow is not supported as NB US-101 connector demand.

This counterfactual maps the station to the NB US-101 HOV connector, adds a second connector lane, connects feeder lanes 3 and 4 to connector lanes 1 and 0, and joins both lanes to receiving lane 5. It exists only to illustrate network sensitivity and must not be interpreted as station mapping or physical geometry.
Compare against the one-lane SR-85 candidate with matching demand dates and random seeds; this isolates network geometry, not a controller effect.
